gallery.description: Scope and content:  The full caption for this photograph reads: Tanforan Assembly center, San Bruno, California. Barracks for family living quarters. Each door enters into a family unit of two small rooms. Tanforan assembly center was opened two days before the photograph was made. On the first day there had been a heavy rain. When a family has arrived here, first step of evacuation is complete.

gallery.description: Scope and content:  The full caption for this photograph reads: San Bruno, California. All maintenance work, repair and construction is done by volunteer workers of Japanese ancestry. The wages are $8.00 per month for 48 hours a week. This gang of boys and young men digging a drainage tank along the front of one of the barracks.

gallery.filename: Photograph of Members of the Mochida Family Awaiting Evacuation - NARA - 537505 - Restoration.png
gallery.title: File:Photograph of Members of the Mochida Family Awaiting Evacuation - NARA - 537505 - Restoration.png
gallery.credit: U.S. National Archives and Records Administration
gallery.source: Photograph of Members of the Mochida Family Awaiting Evacuation
gallery.description: Scope and content:  Original caption: Hayward, California. Members of the Mochida family awaiting evacuation bus. Identification tags are used to aid in keeping the family unit intact during all phases of evacuation. Mochida operated a nursery and five greenhouses on a two-acre site in Eden Township. He raised snapdragons and sweet peas. Evacuees of Japanese ancestry will be housed in War Relocation Authority centers for the duration.
